item.title: Nacho Limits 0.1.2
item.description:
What's new

  • Nacho Limits can now update itself: right-click the notch and choose Check for Updates…, or use Settings > General.
  • The closed notch now says whose limit it is ("Max 98%"), not just a number.
  • Codex can be turned off in Settings > Providers.

Fixes

  • A fresh install no longer shows someone else's account names; your accounts appear under their own folder names, ready to rename.
  • The DeepSeek and NanoGPT key fields are visible again, and pasting a key works.
  • Hovering the notch no longer flashes the wide layout before it opens.

item.title: Nacho Limits 0.1.3
item.description:
Fixes

  • The closed notch shows the full account name again ("Max 1h55m", not "Ma").
  • The installer window points to nacholimits.hexadexa.io.
